title: Android Pie 9 February 2019 Security Bulletin stops xDrip+ from bluetooth connections
body:
I have a Pixel 3 XL, running Android Pie 9 (with January 2019 security patches).  Connecting to a Freestyle Libre via a MiaoMiao bluetooth transmitter. 

Everything was working GREAT -- until yesterday.  Yesterday the Android Security Bulletin — February 2019 was released.  As soon as that was installed on my Pixel 3 XL, then xDrip stopped communicating with the MiaoMiao / Libre connection. 

I reinstall xDrip (the normal release of January 10th 2019 version). Still didn't work. Tried the latest nightly release of February 4, 2019. Still didn't work.

Tried playing with the bluetooth settings. Still won't communicate with the MiaoMiao. 

Elevated all xDrip permissions on my Pixel 3 XL - so xDrip had permissions to do anything. Still wouldn't connect to the MiaoMiao / Libre.

I uninstalled xDrip and install Glimp from the Google Play store. And Glimp immediately connected to the MiaoMiao / Libre. Glimp is working perfectly. 

So trying to find the answer to get xDrip working on my Pixel 3 XL (with the Android Security Bulletin — February 2019).

Here are the Android updates:

https://source.android.com/security/bulletin/2019-02-01
https://source.android.com/security/bulletin/pixel/2019-02-01

Somehow this is blocking the bluetooth connection from a Pie 9 smartphone (Pixel 3 XL running the Feb 2019 security patch). To connect to a bluetooth transmitter (MiaoMiao for Freestyle Libre).

Pixel's are usually the first smartphones to get the new Pie 9 updates, but these updates will filter out to other smartphones soon.  So this may become an issue for xDrip users soon.

Any suggestions?

comments.body:
I read the following comment:

"You have to turn off "Trust Auto-connect" option in the settings. This worked for me."

now it appears to be working. 

Looks like the above post was too hasty....

I'll advise if this changes.
